## Verdict: APPROVE (re-review, iteration 2 — the sole iter-1 blocker VC-9 is fixed; 16/16 checklist PASS; no finding at or above the critical threshold)

All 8 acceptance criteria (VC-1..VC-8) are functionally satisfied by the shipped code and covered by tests. Scope unchanged since iter-1.

## What changed since iteration 1
The fix commit (HEAD `fecba519`) softened the `_humanize_label` docstring only — no behavior change. The prior universally-false idempotence claim ("a humanized label always contains a space or an uppercase letter") was replaced with an exhaustive two-branch characterization: a humanized label "either contains a space or an uppercase letter (so the passthrough branch returns it as-is) or maps to itself under the transform (e.g. a pure-digit word like `2024`), so feeding it back returns it unchanged."
